flows.title: Build a table of companies with Find Companies
steps: In a workbook, click + Add at the bottom, search for Find Companies, and choose it as the source.

Configure the filters you need, such as industries to include or exclude, company size, location, and keywords. Wrap a multi-word keyword in quotes to match that exact phrase, and add a free-text description of your ideal company to rank the results.
Set Limit results. It defaults to 10,000, which is also the maximum.
Click Preview companies, and when the results look good, click Import to new table.
Choose the import options — additional enrichments such as Company Headcount Growth or Most Recent News, and whether auto-update and auto-dedupe are on — then click Continue.

flows.title: Set up a Signal for new hires, job changes or promotions
steps: Open a table of the companies or contacts to monitor. It needs professional social URLs for people, or a company identifier such as the website.
Click Tools → Signals, then select one of the Monitor for... options: new hires, job changes or promotions.
Select the table you want to monitor, identify the correct identifiers, and configure the Signal's filters.
Set how often the Signal should run. Optionally add enrichments to the table, or Add sample results to preview how the data will appear after a change happens.

Click Save and run X rows to finish the Signal. To change it later, click the Signal's column title — it has a 📡 icon and is usually called Event — click Edit signal, then click Save only or Save and re-run.
